fields.name: name
fields.description: The server event to join. It must run now: `events[name]` is set, or `E.abtesting` for `"abtesting"`.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The event runs. The server moves you first when you are not at the event yet (see Also sent). It also sends this reply when `transport_player_to` refused the move: that happens when you are in a generated map (a dream cave), node/server.js:4647.

rows.when: You are in the bank (`player.user` is set).
`name` is `"abtesting"`, and you are not on the `abtesting` map with a team. More than 120 s passed since `timers.abtesting_start`, and `p.abtesting` has no team for this abtesting id.
`name` is not one of the five names, or that event does not run now.

also.when: A move: every client whose view holds your old position, or that was told about you. `to` and `s` are absent when you are invisible (`invis` or `ethereal`) or `stealth`. `s` is also absent for `goobrawl`: that move passes no point.

fields.name: s
fields.description: The point passed to the move: `[x, y, direction, scatter]` (crabxx, franky, icegolem), or a spawn index of the map (abtesting: 2 for team A, 3 for team B). Absent for goobrawl.

also.name: Bets returned
also.when: A move out of the `tavern` while you have open dice bets: the server returns the stakes first (`resend "reopen+nc"`).
also.summary: Your state with the gold of the bets returned.

also.when: A move. The `y` and `x` have a random scatter (40 px for crabxx and franky, 10 px for icegolem, 160 px for the abtesting spawns 2 and 3 in G). `eval` is absent: its variable is never set (the code that sets it is behind `if (0 && ...)`).
also.summary: `{name, in, x, y, direction, effect: 0, info, m, entities}`. See the receive entry.

also.name: At destination
also.when: A move, after `new_map` (`resend "u+cid"`). For abtesting, one more `player` follows (`resend "cid"`), with `team` set.

order: if the server moves you: `disappear` to clients near your old position, `new_map` to you, then `player` to you
